| Non-exact multiples | `page_count(11, 5)` = 3 pages (the classic off-by-one) |
| Boundary in ranges | `even_numbers(10)` includes 10, `even_numbers(9)` excludes 9 |
| Empty collections | `first_n([], 5)`, `binary_search([], 1)`, `last_element([])` |
| Large inputs | `sum_to_n(1000)` validated against Python's `sum(range(1, 1000))` |
| Bug confirmation | Each buggy function is tested to produce the *wrong* result, proving the bug exists |
